log: |rule|Species Clause: Limit one of each Pokémon

decisions.thought: Plan: Rotom-Wash safe lead—Will-O-Wisp physical threats, Volt Switch pivot, Hydro Pump Garganacl/Kingambit. Gholdengo beats Primarina, Garganacl, Fairy/Dragon types and blocks status. Mega Dragonite saved late: Dragon Dance then Extreme Speed/Earthquake/Ice Spinner clean once checks weakened or burned.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating team matchup and threat coverage to select three Pokémon for the 3v3 battle.Assessing type coverage and speed tiers to finalize the three-Pokémon lineup.

decisions.thought:
Lead Primarina: strong matchup against Garchomp, Dragonite, Kingambit, and Mimikyu with Moonblast, Encore, and Aqua Jet.
Back: Dragonite (Lum Berry + Multiscale to absorb Rotom-W Will-O-Wisp and sweep with DD) and Kingambit (switches into Gholdengo's Ghost/Steel moves, beats Mimikyu, and cleans late with Supreme Overlord + Black Glasses).

Plan: Volt Switch Rotom into Gholdengo vs Primarina; Gholdengo resists Fairy, Make It Rain hits Fairy hard, Nasty Plot threat. Save Mega Dragonite late after checks weakened/burned. Rotom pivots/burns physical threats (Kingambit/Sneasler/Dragonite), Hydro vs Garganacl/Kingambit. Watch Primarina speed/coverage.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing Pokémon type matchups and turn options to choose Rotom’s Volt Switch pivot to Gholdengo.

decisions.thought: Opponent leads Rotom-Wash vs my Primarina. Stay in and Moonblast to punish Rotom-W or anything it Volt Switches into (breaks Mimikyu Disguise or Dragonite Multiscale, chunks Gholdengo/Kingambit/Garchomp). Keep Dragonite's Multiscale and Lum Berry intact in the back for setup later, and save Kingambit for Gholdengo/Mimikyu/late-game cleanup.

Plan: Gholdengo vs Primarina (54% after Volt Switch) — Make It Rain threatens KO, Nasty Plot if they switch. Save Mega Dragonite late after checks weakened/burned. Rotom pivots/burns physical threats (Kingambit/Sneasler/Dragonite), Hydro vs Garganacl/Kingambit. Watch Primarina coverage/speed.

Plan: Nasty Plot now—Primarina at 54% likely switches fearing Make It Rain; if it stays, Moonblast (~25%) won't KO and +2 Make It Rain finishes it. +2 Gholdengo threatens Kingambit/Garganacl/mirror with Shadow Ball/Make It Rain. Save Mega Dragonite late; Rotom pivots and burns physical threats.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating damage calculations and switch-in matchups for Gholdengo versus Primarina and potential replacements.

decisions.thought: Opponent has Rotom-W (Volt Switch) and Leftovers Gholdengo (took 25% from Moonblast, so likely bulky Nasty Plot/Make It Rain/Shadow Ball/Recover). Stay in with Primarina to Sparkling Aria: Gholdengo doesn't KO from 101 HP unless Nasty Plot first, and Aria deals ~45-55% or hits a switch-in. Save Kingambit and Dragonite at 100% HP.

Gholdengo outspeeds Primarina; its Sparkling Aria did 102 damage, so attack now before it KOs. +2 Make It Rain should KO Primarina and hit Garganacl/Dragonite switch-ins; Kingambit resists it. Save Mega Dragonite late; Rotom pivots and burns physical threats.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Comparing damage calculations and speed tiers to determine if Gholdengo can KO Primarina before being KOed.Evaluating switch-in matchups and move damage to confirm the KO before Primarina acts.

decisions.thought: Opponent has Rotom-W (Volt Switch) and Leftovers Gholdengo at 35% HP (+2 SpA, Nasty Plot). Good as Gold blocks Encore. Use Sparkling Aria with Primarina to KO Gholdengo if it attacks or force Recover stall, letting Kingambit (Black Glasses + Supreme Overlord) or Dragonite (Lum Berry + Multiscale) clean up after Primarina faints.

Opponent has Rotom-W (100% HP, Volt Switch), Leftovers Gholdengo (41% HP, +1 SpA, Nasty Plot/Make It Rain), and 1 unseen. Bring in Kingambit: it resists Gholdengo's STABs, threatens a KO or heavy Kowtow Cleave damage onto Rotom-W switch-in, and preserves Dragonite's Multiscale and Lum Berry to sweep later.

Primarina fainted; Kingambit has Supreme Overlord (1 ally down). Gholdengo at 41%, SpA neutral, threatened by Sucker Punch/Kowtow—save it for third foe. Rotom-Wash switches in to scout and Will-O-Wisp Kingambit; Dragonite (Mega, Multiscale intact) saved late with Earthquake for Kingambit.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing Pokemon damage and move priority to determine if Recover avoids Sucker Punch and survives Kowtow Cleave.Evaluating speed order, damage ranges, and type matchups to compare Recover versus switching to Rotom-Wash or Dragonite.

decisions.thought: Opponent has Leftovers Gholdengo (41% HP, +0 SpA after Make It Rain drop), Rotom-W (100% HP, Volt Switch), and 1 unseen (Dragonite/Garchomp/Kingambit/Mimikyu). Use Kowtow Cleave: it KOs Gholdengo or punishes Recover/switches (like Rotom-W) heavily with Black Glasses + Supreme Overlord boost, whereas Sucker Punch fails vs Recover or switch. Save Dragonite (Multiscale + Lum Berry) to sweep.

Primarina fainted; Kingambit Supreme Overlord (1 down), Kowtow did 85 to Rotom. Rotom at 111 survives another hit, so Will-O-Wisp to cripple Kingambit and any physical third (Sneasler/Dragonite/Garganacl). Then Pain Split/pivot; save Gholdengo (41%) and healthy Dragonite with Earthquake for late game.

Opponent has Rotom-W (70% HP, Sitrus Berry consumed, Volt Switch; took 55% from Kowtow Cleave), Leftovers Gholdengo (41% HP, Nasty Plot/Make It Rain), and 1 unseen (Dragonite/Garchomp/Kingambit/Mimikyu). Keep Kingambit in to Kowtow Cleave: it avoids Sucker Punch failing vs Will-O-Wisp, heavily chips Rotom-W or a Volt Switch target, and preserves Dragonite's Multiscale + Lum Berry to sweep.

Kingambit burned, Kowtow now ~40 to Rotom. Pain Split heals Rotom (~71 to ~125) and drops Kingambit to ~65%, safe vs Sucker Punch. Then Volt Switch to healthy Mega Dragonite for Earthquake; save Gholdengo 41% for unknown third (Dragonite/Gholdengo/Sneasler/Garganacl).
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing damage calculations and comparing Pain Split versus Volt Switch for Rotom against Kingambit while considering a potential Dragonite pivot.

decisions.thought: Opponent has Rotom-W (45% HP, Sitrus used, Volt Switch/Will-O-Wisp; takes 25% from burned Kowtow Cleave), Leftovers Gholdengo (41% HP, Nasty Plot/Make It Rain), and 1 unseen (Dragonite/Garchomp/Kingambit/Mimikyu). Use Swords Dance to negate the burn Attack drop on Kingambit while surviving Rotom's attack easily, then break through Rotom-W/Gholdengo so Dragonite (Multiscale + Lum Berry) can sweep.

Kingambit burned, +2 Atk, 58%; Rotom healed to 133 via Pain Split. Volt Switch chips Kingambit to ensure Dragonite Earthquake KO, avoiding staying in. Dragonite Multiscale intact can take a burned Sucker Punch. Save Gholdengo at 41% for unknown third; Rotom can later burn/check it.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Comparing burned Kingambit Kowtow damage at +2 versus +0 to decide between attacking Rotom now or Volt Switching into Dragonite.Evaluating Volt Switch versus Hydro Pump against Sucker Punch priority and Multiscale interaction.

decisions.thought: Opponent has Rotom-W (84% HP, Sitrus used, Volt Switch/Will-O-Wisp/Pain Split, likely Hydro Pump), Leftovers Gholdengo (41% HP, Nasty Plot/Make It Rain), and 1 unseen (Dragonite/Garchomp/Kingambit/Mimikyu). At +2 Atk (burned = +0 effective), Kowtow Cleave does ~55% to Rotom-W. Use Kowtow Cleave to heavily damage Rotom-W or a Volt Switch target, keeping Dragonite's Multiscale + Lum Berry intact to sweep.

Kingambit burned, +2 Atk, 33%; Primarina fainted. Dragonite healthy with Multiscale can take burned Sucker Punch and KO with Earthquake (Mega next turn if needed). Save Gholdengo 41% and Rotom 85% for unknown third: Dragonite/Gholdengo/Sneasler/Garganacl.

Kingambit burned, +2 Atk, 28%; Primarina fainted. Mega Earthquake KOs Kingambit; Mega bulk helps survive burned Sucker Punch. Save Gholdengo 41% and Rotom 85% for unknown third: Dragonite/Gholdengo/Sneasler/Garganacl. After KO, adapt: Extreme Speed vs Sneasler, Earthquake vs Gholdengo/Garganacl.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Earthquake versus Sucker Punch damage and Mega evolution bulk to secure the KO while weighing saving Mega for later.

decisions.thought: Opponent has Dragonite (66% HP, Multiscale broken), Rotom-W (84% HP, Sitrus used, Volt Switch/Will-O-Wisp/Pain Split), and Leftovers Gholdengo (41% HP, Nasty Plot/Make It Rain). Sucker Punch does ~56% to Dragonite, while Extreme Speed does ~20% (46 HP) to Kingambit, letting us survive and KO if they Dragon Dance or switch. Then our Dragonite (Multiscale + Lum Berry) cleans up.

decisions.note: Only one legal action: played without asking.

decisions.thought: Primarina and Kingambit fainted; opponent only Dragonite left at 100%, likely Multiscale. Our Mega Dragonite at 11% is saved for Extreme Speed revenge. Rotom resists/immune to likely Ice Spinner/Earthquake, can burn with Will-O-Wisp, then Hydro Pump/Pain Split stall; Gholdengo held as backup attacker.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Calculating damage with Multiscale and type effectiveness under abstract output constraints.Evaluating priority interaction and damage after chip to choose the finishing move.Comparing Extreme Speed safety against Ice Spinner risk and evaluating Rotom as a switch-in.

decisions.thought: Opponent has Mega Dragonite (11% HP, faster base Speed), Rotom-W (84% HP, Sitrus used, Volt Switch/Will-O-Wisp/Pain Split), and Leftovers Gholdengo (41% HP, Nasty Plot/Make It Rain). Use Extreme Speed to KO Mega Dragonite before it can hit us with a Dragon move, preserving HP and Lum Berry to set up Dragon Dance against Rotom-W or KO Gholdengo with Earthquake.

Primarina and Kingambit fainted; only opposing Dragonite at 100% left, likely Multiscale. Burn it with Rotom to halve its physical damage and chip it, breaking Multiscale. Then Pain Split/Hydro Pump stall, finish with our Mega Dragonite's Extreme Speed or Gholdengo's Shadow Ball.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Reconstructing HP and move history to verify Rotom's current HP and Multiscale status before deciding the Extreme Speed revenge.

decisions.thought: Opponent has Rotom-W (60% HP, Sitrus used, Volt Switch/Will-O-Wisp/Pain Split), Leftovers Gholdengo (41% HP), and Mega Dragonite (11% HP). We have Multiscale + Lum Berry intact. Dragon Dance boosts Atk/Spe; if Rotom uses Will-O-Wisp, Lum Berry cures it while keeping Multiscale, and if it Volt Switches, we still outspeed all three at +1 to sweep with Outrage/Earthquake/Extreme Speed.

Primarina and Kingambit fainted; only opposing Dragonite left at 100%, +1 Atk/Spe, Lum Berry consumed. Burn it again with Rotom to halve damage and break Multiscale via chip. Then Pain Split/Hydro Pump stall, finish with Mega Dragonite Extreme Speed or Gholdengo Shadow Ball.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing battle state and damage calculations to determine Rotom's optimal move against Dragonite.

decisions.thought: Opponent has Rotom-W (60% HP), Leftovers Gholdengo (41% HP), and Mega Dragonite (11% HP). At +1 Atk, Extreme Speed did 24% unboosted (~36% at +1), so we must use Outrage (~81% damage) to OHKO Rotom-W before it can Will-O-Wisp again. After Outrage ends, clean up Gholdengo with Earthquake and Mega Dragonite with Extreme Speed.

Primarina/Kingambit fainted; only +1/+1 Dragonite at 100% left, Lum used, Multiscale likely intact. Rotom fainted. Send Gholdengo: Steel resists Outrage/Extreme Speed. Use Make It Rain to break Multiscale and chip, then Shadow Ball/second hit, finish with our Mega Dragonite Extreme Speed revenge.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating damage and move matchups to choose a safe switch against a boosted Dragonite.Assessing speed tiers and priority to rule out leading with Dragonite and favor Gholdengo.

decisions.note: Only one legal action: played without asking.

decisions.thought: Primarina/Kingambit fainted; only +1/+1 Dragonite left at 100%, Lum used, likely Multiscale, locked into Outrage (turn 11 first hit). Gholdengo at 41% may die before attacking, so Recover to guarantee surviving next Outrage, break Multiscale with Make It Rain, then Shadow Ball; save Mega Dragonite Extreme Speed to finish.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Gholdengo's damage survivability against a boosted Dragonite Outrage under type resistance.Assessing Earthquake as a super-effective KO risk and Make It Rain damage with Multiscale reduction.Comparing Recover stall versus immediate Make It Rain against Outrage lock and priority revenge.

decisions.note: Only one legal action: played without asking.

decisions.thought: Only our 20HP Mega Dragonite vs +1/+1 opposing Dragonite at 100%, likely Multiscale, now confused after Outrage. Extreme Speed cannot KO through Multiscale. Ice Spinner is 4x effective: if confusion self-hit breaks Multiscale or chips first, Ice Spinner can KO; otherwise we lose.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing a Gen 5 Pokemon battle turn to determine speed and move priority for a KO.Comparing damage ranges against Multiscale and priority to confirm a KO is not possible.

decisions.thought: Opponent's last Pokemon is Mega Dragonite at 11% HP. We are at +1 Atk, +1 Spe, 100% HP (Multiscale active). Use Extreme Speed (+2 priority) to outspeed any potential opposing Extreme Speed and easily KO Mega Dragonite to win the game.
